entries.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: single transparent 256x256 top-down RTS sniper walk animation sprite. Image 1 is the approved sniper identity, exact upper-body/rifle proportions, weathered bright aqua armor color and cloak authority; image 2 is only a gait pose reference. Edit image 1 into walk frame 5 (right contact). Keep north-facing entire body and rifle barrel exactly north/up at 12 o'clock. Preserve narrow adult silhouette, hood/helmet, gloves, tan-brown weathered cloak, boots, small aqua body armor panels, long rifle, muzzle at top. Retain same overhead view, lighting, crisp game-art texture, exact head/torso/rifle length and width. Pose: SCREEN-RIGHT boot is north/forward, SCREEN-LEFT boot south/trailing, opposite left-contact pose. Right thigh flexed forward and left leg extended back, subtle cloak fold shift. Only subtle legs, hem and hand motion; no change in overall body size, no giant stride, no new equipment. Rifle stays centered upright and feet face north. Center same pivot and overall occupied height in square canvas, about 14px padding at 256 size. Actual transparent background alpha, isolated character, no text, no shadow, no floor, no border, no grid or checkerboard. One frame only.
